steps.en: Install the extension and choose an allowed speech-recognition route
steps.zh: 安装扩展，选择允许的语音识别路径

steps.en: Click its button in your authorized reCAPTCHA challenge
steps.zh: 在授权的 reCAPTCHA 挑战中点击按钮

steps.en: Switch to audio and request transcription through the selected route
steps.zh: 切换音频题，经所选路径请求转写

steps.en: Fill available text and submit it for the target to verify
steps.zh: 填入取得的文本，交目标系统验证

value.en: A user-triggered audio answer submission instead of manually reading image puzzles
value.zh: 由用户触发音频答案提交，不必手动辨认图片题
